sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Finance Fourth Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2004
ACT III OF 2004
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
(FOURTH AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2003.
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Finance Act, 1996.
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary 14th January, 2004]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis-I/2004/1327,dated
14th January 2004.---------The North-West Frontier Province
Finance (Fourth Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on the 29th December, 2003 and
assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 7th
January, 2004 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
the North West Frontier Province.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Finance (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Finance Fourth Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Amendment of section 11 of N.-W.F.P. Act No.1 of 1996

ACT III OF 2004
ACT III OF 2004
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
(FOURTH AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2003.
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Finance Act, 1996.
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary 14th January, 2004]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis-I/2004/1327,dated
14th January 2004.---------The North-West Frontier Province
Finance (Fourth Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on the 29th December, 2003 and
assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 7th
January, 2004 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
the North West Frontier Province.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
2. Amendment of section 11 of
N.-W.F.P. Act No.1 of 1996.---In the North West Frontier Province Finance
Act, 1996) (N.-W.F.P. Act No. I of 1996), in section 11, for subsection (1),
the following subsections shall be substituted, namely:--
"11. Tobacco Development
Cess.---(1) There shall be levied and collected development cess on tobacco
at the following rates, namely:
(a)
for Virginia (flue-cured,
burley and dark-air-cured);
Rs.2.00 per kilogram.
(b)
for white patta/rustica tobacco
including khaka, kera and roth made of mainstalk (dandi) and stem of tobacco;
and
Re. 1.00 per kilogram
(c)
for snuff/niswar
Re.0.70 per kilogram.
(1a) The cess shall be recovered
from--
(a) cigarette manufacturing
factories and tobacco processing factories on the basis of quota fixed for the
factory concerned by the Pakistan Toabacco Board; and
(b) person dealing in tobacco
business, who are transporting tobacco outside the Zone of its production:
Provided that cigarette
manufacturing factories and tobacco processing factories shall not be liable to
pay the cess on tobacco on which cess has already been paid under clause (b):
Provided further that no cess
shall be charged on the tobacco being transported, for which the cess has
already been paid under clause (a).
EXPLANATION.---
For the purpose of this
section,----
(i) there shall be the following Zones,
namely:
Zone-I.
District of Charsadda, Swabi,
Mardan, Nowshera, Tehsil Dargi and District Buner;
Zone-II
District Mansehra;
Zone-III
Districts of Chitral, Dir and
Swat (which includes Kalam) and Malakand Protected Area; and
Such others Zones as Government
may, from time to time, by notification in the official Gazette, specify; and
(ii) the word 'person' used in
clause (b) of subsection (1a) shall also include cigarette manufacturing
factories and tobacco processing factories, if these factories are transporting
tobacco outside the Zone in addition to the quota allocated to them by the
Pakistan Tobacco Board.".
